blocks.title: Key vocabulary
items: accessibility — Use by people with varied needs.

blocks.title: Understand
blocks.text: Digital infrastructure consumes electricity and hardware resources; energy demand, device lifetimes, repairability and electronic waste are part of environmental evaluation.

blocks.title: Apply
blocks.text: Censorship and moderation can restrict harmful content, but also threaten freedom of expression and access to information. Evaluate proportionate rules, appeals and transparency.

blocks.title: Evaluate
blocks.text: Accessible design goes beyond attractive colours: sufficient contrast, structural headings, meaningful labels, keyboard access, language/character support and alternatives to colour-only cues.

blocks.title: Worked example · Predict first
blocks.text: Colour-only status is inaccessible to users with some colour-vision differences.

blocks.title: Worked example · Explain
blocks.text: Add words and/or shapes alongside adequate contrast; do not rely on colour as the sole signal.
